decision_reviewed: Root Project Scope Unit ID CA-SU-00; predefined Scope Unit CA-SU--1 named world has no Scope Unit Declaration; root Project Declaration Atom defaults to a scope_unit mapping to world.

proposal_reviews.finding: Formal form models one Header.Container object with exactly one key selected from `atom` or `scope_unit`; no direct scalar/list value is admitted. Prose makes the root Project Declaration omission an effective fallback mapping whose only key is scope_unit=CA-SU--1, and allows an explicit valid override. It does not assert both keys or require a world carrier/folder.

Every Atom, including the root Project Declaration Atom, has exactly one outgoing IS_CONTAINED_BY resolved from effective Header.Container. The preview removes the world zero-edge exception and says Header.Container is the sole stored Atom-containment value; this is consistent with a derived edge and adds no duplicate Header.Relations value.
The leaf property is an optional string whose existing semantics identify a stable Scope Unit ID. R2779 supplies exactly one key and requires stable-ID resolution.
The leaf property permits only an optional base Atom ID. R2779 supplies the required exactly-one-key group. No additional path or version syntax is introduced.

The preview excludes Project and ID CA-SU--1 from the exactly-one-parent requirement. It preserves the existing 0..1 general parent bound; it does not assert that world has zero or one parent. Project having no parent must come from the separate Project rule, not this exemption.

world_presence_check.finding: No Current world/CA-SU--1 source declaration or physical folder was found in the scanned markdown authority tree. The proposed bootstrap identity is not materialized as a carrier or folder.

adoption_gates: The R2523 change is a preview of Current R2523@3; it must be rebased into a fresh Draft/successor before any source adoption, and the accepted :: count-syntax migration must be reconciled in that full body.

Current-to-Delivery reader validation for the new effective Header.Container-to-IS_CONTAINED_BY mapping remains a separate gate; this review does not validate runtime/materialization.
